# ESA-SCBO 2022

The joint conference of the Ecological Society of Australia and the Society for Conservation Biology Oceania was held in Wollongong, NSW from 28 November to 2 December 2022. 

The theme of the conference was *Reconnecting: Reconnecting with Nature, Reconnecting with Each Other*.
